scope_note: Three frozen valid requests, one per advertised capability (energy scan, MadAnalysis, user-UFO/BSM). Each is sourced from pre-existing released tests/UI material and was frozen BEFORE any live model result. This is a small supplementary coverage check, separate from the primary experiment, the 50-request extension, the three-way baseline, and the containment statistics. Models: qwen2.5-coder:7b and qwen3-coder-next:Q4_K_M only.

requests.request_text: Simulate proton-proton collisions producing an electron and a positron. Do an energy scan from 1 TeV to 5 TeV in steps of 500 GeV. Generate 100 events per point.
requests.notes: Released entry point: prepare_energy_scan. Expected: PreparedEnergyScan.is_ready True, 9 points, 100 events/point, base workflow e+ e- with no Pythia8/Delphes/MA5.

requests.request_text: Simulate proton-proton collisions producing an electron and a positron at 13 TeV. Generate 10 events and create default plots.
requests.notes: Released entry point: prepare_end_to_end. Expected: READY_FOR_APPROVAL with pipeline.madanalysis=True and intent preserved.

requests.request_text: At a 13 TeV proton-proton collider, generate p p > x1+ x1- using the MSSM UFO model at <HEPLOCALAGENT_EVIDENCE_ROOT>/.hep-stack/madgraph/models/MSSM_SLHA2. Generate 100 events. Do not use Pythia8, Delphes, or MadAnalysis.
requests.source_case: BSM fixture semantics (x1/xd) + real managed MSSM_SLHA2 model
requests.notes: Released entry point: prepare_end_to_end. Expected: READY_FOR_APPROVAL with model.source=user_ufo, model_path set, process p p > x1+ x1-, 13 TeV, 100 events. The synthetic validation-only particles.py fixture is NOT used for runtime; MSSM_SLHA2 is a real MG5 model shipped in the managed stack.
